name: curl
description: Command line tool and library for transferring files using URL syntax.
install: cd curl-8.18.0 && rm -rf docs/examples/.deps && find docs \( -name Makefile\* -o -name \*.1 -o -name \*.3 -o -name CMakeLists.txt \) -delete && mkdir -p "$DESTDIR$PREFIX/share/doc/curl-8.18.0" && cp -v -R docs/* "$DESTDIR$PREFIX/share/doc/curl-8.18.0/"
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
